paragraphs: The GLE450 has been part of the GLE-Class range since 2015. Earlier W166-generation cars use the M276 - a 3.0-litre V6 petrol. From 2019, the V167-generation GLE450 switched to the M256, a newer 3.0-litre inline-six petrol with mild hybrid technology - a different unit entirely, not an evolution of the M276. Knowing which one your car has matters, because the engine architecture, components, and rebuild specifics differ between them - which is exactly why we confirm your exact engine by registration before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace M256 engines for every GLE450 on the road.

cards.body: A 3.0-litre inline-six petrol mild-hybrid engine fitted to the GLE450 from 2023 to present. The M256 features an integrated starter-generator (ISG) and electric auxiliary compressor, making it a more modern and efficient design than the older M276 V6. We replace timing chains, bearings, water pump and gaskets as standard on every M256 rebuild.

compatibility.intro: Because the GLE450 spans two distinct engines across two generations, fitting the wrong replacement - or assuming an M276 part will work on an M256 car - risks a compatibility problem that's expensive to unpick. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm: - Your exact engine code (M276 or M256) via registration or VIN - Your generation (W166 or V167) - Drivetrain and ancillary specification - Any electronics or ECU considerations specific to your exact build
